newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms a shade vs dollar and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms a shade vs dollar and basket.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Hungary's forint ended quiet Tuesday morning trade slightly firmer against the dollar and currency basket.
* At midday, the forint stood at 196.18/23 to the dollar, compared to an opening 196.25/30.

* The forint continued to move closer to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), ending at midday about six pips from the bid, compared to eight to ten pips at the opening and 15 to 20 on Monday.
* Dealers said the recent spate of forex buying was over and sales would likely emerge on Tuesday.
* The NBH fixed the forint/dollar at 196.17 at noon.
(The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
